summary: VSee Health filed an 8-K reporting an additional tranche under its existing June 18, 2026 securities purchase agreement with institutional investor Vanquish. On September 24, 2026, the company issued an additional unsecured convertible promissory note with $180,550 principal, including $23,550 original issue discount, carrying a one-time 12% interest charge applied at issuance and maturing July 30, 2027. The note converts only during an Event of Default, subject to a non-waivable 4.99% beneficial ownership cap, and may be prepaid penalty-free. This is routine financing, not a special situation; watch dilution and default triggers.
